plugins/auditsecurity/plugin_info/config.Relance l'audit en tâche de fond et met: Runs the audit in the background and updates the device score. The weekly audit runs on Mondays.
plugins/auditsecurity/plugin_info/config.Ajoute un message dans le centre de mess: Adds a message to the Jeedom message center when a passing check no longer passes.
plugins/auditsecurity/plugin_info/config.Désactivé par défaut. Une fois activé, l: Disabled by default. Once enabled, the public IP address of your connection is sent to third-party services to check what is visible from the Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/plugin_info/config.Services contactés : api.ipify.org (seul: Services contacted: api.ipify.org (only if the Internet router does not give the public IP address through UPnP), internetdb.shodan.io, and the blacklists zen.spamhaus.org, b.barracudacentral.org and bl.spamcop.net (DNS queries).
plugins/auditsecurity/plugin_info/config.En niveau de log Debug, le plugin écrit: At the Debug log level, the plugin writes in the auditsecurity log the details of each check: duration, system commands run, requests and results. Sensitive data (passwords, hashes) is never written.
plugins/auditsecurity/plugin_info/config.Passez le niveau de log sur Debug (cadre: Set the log level to Debug (Logs and monitoring panel above), run the audit again, then click Diagnostic on the plugin page and attach the downloaded file to your message on the forum. Then set the log level back to default.

plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un audit est déjà en cours, patientez qu: An audit is already running, please wait a few seconds.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Aucune correction automatique pour ce co: No automatic fix for this check
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Audit de sécurité : fin de la période d': Security audit: ignore period over, check(s) counted in the score again: %s

plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le fichier /etc/apache2/conf-available/s: The file /etc/apache2/conf-available/security.conf will be replaced with the one provided by Jeedom (the current one is saved as security.conf.auditsecurity.bak), the headers module enabled and Apache reloaded. If the configuration is invalid, the previous one is restored. This configuration prevents displaying Jeedom inside a page of another site (iframe) and restricts external content: a dashboard that embeds Jeedom, or a plugin that displays an external site, may stop working.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Compte admin avec le mot de passe par dé: Admin account with the default password
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le couple admin / admin est le premier e: The admin / admin pair is the first one tried by bots scanning the Internet. If it works, the attacker controls the whole house.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Changez le mot de passe du compte admin,: Change the password of the admin account, or create a named administrator and disable the admin account.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le plugin essaie, sans se connecter, une: Without logging in, the plugin tries a list of the most used passwords (jeedom, 123456, qwerty, login = password...) on each active account.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Utilisez des mots de passe longs et uniq: Use long, unique passwords (a passphrase or a password manager).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.L'accès support crée le compte jeedom_su: Support access creates the jeedom_support account, which lets Jeedom support log in to your box. It should only stay open for the duration of an intervention.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Fermez l'accès support une fois l'interv: Close support access once the intervention is over.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le compte jeedom_support va être désacti: The jeedom_support account will be disabled.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom demande le code de double authent: Jeedom asks for the two-factor authentication (2FA) code when logging in from outside. Without 2FA, a stolen or guessed password is enough to take control from the Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Activez la double authentification sur c: Enable two-factor authentication on each administrator account (Profile > Security), at least if Jeedom is reachable from the Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Chaque compte administrateur est une por: Each administrator account is a full entry point. The fewer there are, the smaller the attack surface.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Gardez trois administrateurs au plus ; d: Keep at most three administrators; give the User or Limited user profile to the other accounts.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un compte actif qui ne sert plus (ancien: An active account that is no longer used (former occupant, test account...) remains an entry point that nobody watches. Only logins through the web interface are recorded: an account used only by the mobile app or the API may appear here by mistake.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Désactivez ou supprimez les comptes sans: Disable or delete accounts with no login for more than 6 months.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom peut bannir une adresse IP après: Jeedom can ban an IP address after several failed logins. Without this protection, a bot can try thousands of passwords.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Gardez un nombre d'échecs autorisés bas: Keep a low number of allowed failures (6 by default) and a non-zero ban duration.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.6 échecs autorisés sur 5 minutes, bannis: 6 allowed failures over 5 minutes, 10-minute ban (Jeedom default values).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les adresses de la liste blanche ne sont: Whitelisted addresses are never banned and can use the API in "White IP" mode. A too broad entry (*.*.*.*) disables these protections for the whole Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Limitez la liste blanche aux plages de v: Limit the whitelist to your local network ranges (e.g. 192.168.1.*).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les entrées qui couvrent tout Internet s: Entries covering the whole Internet will be removed and entries that are too broad reduced to their private part (e.g. 172.*.*.* becomes 172.16.0.0/12). Specific public addresses are not changed.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une session très longue reste utilisable: A very long session remains usable for a long time on a lost or shared device.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Gardez une durée de session raisonnable: Keep a reasonable session duration (24 h by default). Trusted devices can be registered to avoid retyping the password.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.En HTTP, le mot de passe et tous les éch: Over HTTP, the password and all exchanges travel in clear text over the Internet and can be intercepted (public Wi-Fi, provider...).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Utilisez le DNS Jeedom (HTTPS inclus) ou: Use Jeedom DNS (HTTPS included) or a reverse proxy with a certificate (Let's Encrypt), and declare the external access as https://.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Ports ouverts sur la box Internet par UP: Ports opened on the Internet router by UPnP
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Avec UPnP, n'importe quel appareil ou pr: With UPnP, any device or program on the local network can open a port on your Internet router without asking you. The plugin queries the router to list these openings, especially those pointing to Jeedom. Port forwards created by hand on the router are not visible to this check.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Supprimez les redirections vers Jeedom (: Remove the forwards to Jeedom (use Jeedom DNS or a VPN), then disable UPnP on the Internet router if no device needs it.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Shodan scanne Internet en permanence. Sa: Shodan constantly scans the Internet. Its InternetDB database gives, for your public IP address, the ports seen open and the known vulnerabilities of the detected services. This is what any attacker sees. InternetDB does not date its observations: they may be several weeks or even several months old. Vulnerabilities are inferred from the version announced by each service, without being verified. This information covers the whole connection (Internet router and other devices included).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Vérifiez d'abord depuis l'extérieur que: First check from outside that these ports are still open, for example from a phone on 4G/5G (Wi-Fi off) or with an online port testing service. If they are, close unnecessary port forwardings in the Internet router and update the services reported as vulnerable. If they are closed, the alert will disappear once Shodan has scanned the address again.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les listes noires (Spamhaus, Barracuda,: Blacklists (Spamhaus, Barracuda, SpamCop) list the addresses that send spam or belong to a network of hacked machines. Being listed may point to a compromised device in your home. Consumer address ranges (Spamhaus PBL list) are not counted as a problem.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Recherchez l'appareil compromis (ordinat: Find the compromised device (computer, camera, connected object), clean it, then request the removal of the address on the blacklist website.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Certificat HTTPS de l'accès externe: HTTPS certificate of the external access
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un certificat expiré, auto-signé ou émis: An expired, self-signed certificate or one issued for another name makes the browser show a warning and gets you used to ignoring it, which opens the door to interception.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Utilisez un certificat reconnu (Let's En: Use a trusted certificate (Let's Encrypt) and check that its automatic renewal works.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.En mode « Activé », une API répond depui: In "Enabled" mode, an API answers from any address, including the Internet when Jeedom is exposed to it. "White IP" mode restricts it to trusted addresses (your local network).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Passez les API en mode « IP blanche » (o: Switch the APIs to "White IP" mode (or "Disabled" if you do not use them).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les API listées n'accepteront plus que l: The listed APIs will only accept whitelisted addresses. Services calling them from the Internet (webhooks, IFTTT, apps outside the local network...) will stop working.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une clé API courte peut être devinée. Je: A short API key can be guessed. Jeedom generates 64-character keys; a shorter key was typed by hand.
Regenerate API keys that are too short.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Régénérer les clés trop courtes: Regenerate keys that are too short
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.De nouvelles clés vont être générées. To: New keys will be generated. All services using the old keys will have to be reconfigured.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les mises à jour du core corrigent régul: Core updates regularly fix security vulnerabilities.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Faites une sauvegarde puis mettez Jeedom: Make a backup, then update Jeedom.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un plugin obsolète peut contenir une fai: An outdated plugin may contain a vulnerability fixed since.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Mettez à jour les plugins depuis le cent: Update plugins from the update center.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un plugin installé depuis GitHub, une UR: A plugin installed from GitHub, a URL or a file has not been checked by the Jeedom Market and runs with all of Jeedom's rights.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.N'installez hors Market que des plugins: Only install plugins from outside the Market when you know their author.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.En Debug, les logs peuvent contenir des: In Debug, logs may contain passwords, API keys or tokens, and grow until the disk is full.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.N'activez le niveau Debug que le temps d: Only enable the Debug level for the duration of a diagnosis.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les logs listés repasseront au niveau pa: The listed logs will go back to the Jeedom default level (Error for the global level).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Fichiers sensibles accessibles depuis le: Sensitive files reachable from the browser
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les dossiers log, backup et core/config: The log, backup and core/config folders must never be downloadable: backups contain the full database (passwords, API keys). The plugin drops a test file and checks that Apache refuses to serve it.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Vérifiez qu'Apache prend en compte les f: Check that Apache takes Jeedom's .htaccess files into account (AllowOverride All on /var/www/html).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les en-têtes X-Frame-Options et X-Conten: The X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options headers protect against embedding Jeedom in a trapped page (clickjacking) and some injections.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Utilisez la configuration Apache de sécu: Use the Apache security configuration provided by Jeedom. This check queries Apache locally: if a reverse proxy in front of Jeedom adds these headers, you can ignore it.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Versions exposées par le serveur web: Versions exposed by the web server
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les en-têtes Server et X-Powered-By donn: The Server and X-Powered-By headers give the exact Apache and PHP versions, which helps an attacker target known vulnerabilities.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Masquez les versions (ServerTokens Prod,: Hide the versions (ServerTokens Prod, removal of X-Powered-By). This check queries Apache locally: if a reverse proxy in front of Jeedom hides these headers, you can ignore it.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une version de PHP en fin de support ne: A PHP version at end of support no longer receives security fixes. The PHP provided by Debian keeps being fixed by Debian as long as the Debian version is supported, even after the official end of support of PHP.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Mettez à jour le système d'exploitation: Update the operating system to get a supported PHP version.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une version de Debian en fin de support: A Debian version at end of support no longer receives security fixes (kernel, OpenSSL, Apache, SSH...).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Migrez vers une version de Debian suppor: Migrate to a supported Debian version (following the Jeedom documentation, after a backup).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les images Jeedom et Raspberry Pi sont l: Jeedom and Raspberry Pi images ship with well-known passwords (Mjeedom96, raspberry...). Without logging in, the plugin compares them with the root, jeedom, pi accounts and the system user accounts.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Connectez-vous en SSH et changez le mot: Log in over SSH and change the password of each listed account with the passwd command.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Autoriser root à se connecter en SSH ave: Allowing root to log in over SSH with a password directly exposes the most powerful account to brute-force attacks.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Interdisez la connexion root par mot de: Forbid root password login (PermitRootLogin prohibit-password) and use a normal account with sudo, or an SSH key.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.root ne pourra plus se connecter en SSH: root will no longer be able to log in over SSH with a password (SSH keys are still accepted). Check BEFORE that you have another account able to log in over SSH and use sudo, otherwise you will lose root SSH access. Open sessions are not closed.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les clés SSH sont bien plus robustes que: SSH keys are much stronger than passwords against brute-force attacks.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Si vous utilisez SSH régulièrement, pass: If you use SSH regularly, switch to SSH keys, then disable PasswordAuthentication.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une horloge décalée fait échouer la doub: A drifting clock makes two-factor authentication and HTTPS certificate checks fail, and distorts the logs.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.La commande timedatectl set-ntp true va: The command timedatectl set-ntp true will be run.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les paquets Debian reçoivent des correct: Debian packages receive security fixes that must be installed.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Faites une sauvegarde puis lancez la mis: Make a backup, then run the system update (sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade), or the one offered by Jeedom.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Certaines mises à jour (noyau, bibliothè: Some updates (kernel, system libraries) only apply after a reboot: until then, the old vulnerable version stays in memory.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Redémarrez la box à un moment opportun (: Reboot the box at a convenient time (Settings > System > Reboot).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le fichier core/config/common.config.php: The core/config/common.config.php file contains the database password. It must not be readable by every account on the system.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Restreignez ses droits en lecture au ser: Restrict its read permissions to the web server (640).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le fichier ne sera plus lisible que par: The file will only be readable by the web server.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les dossiers backup (sauvegardes contena: The backup (backups containing the whole database), log (passwords and tokens in Debug mode) and core/config folders must only be accessible to the web server, not to the other accounts on the system.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Retirez l'accès « autres » à ces dossier: Remove "others" access to these folders (chmod o-rwx). The web server keeps its access.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.L'accès « autres » va être retiré aux do: "Others" access will be removed from the listed folders (chmod o-rwx). The files they contain, including future backups, will no longer be accessible to the other accounts on the system.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un fichier SUID ou SGID s'exécute avec l: A SUID or SGID file runs with the rights of its owner, often root. Jeedom and its plugins never need one: their presence is a classic sign of a compromise or a serious mistake.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Identifiez l'origine des fichiers listés: Find out where the listed files come from. If in doubt, consider the box compromised: restore a clean backup on a reinstalled system and change all passwords.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un fichier de Jeedom modifiable par n'im: A Jeedom file writable by any account on the system lets a compromised program inject code into it.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le droit d'écriture « autres » va être r: The "others" write permission will be removed from all Jeedom files (chmod -R o-w).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom a besoin que le serveur web (www-: Jeedom needs the web server (www-data) to be able to run commands as root. As a result, a vulnerability in Jeedom or a plugin gives full control of the system: hence the importance of the other points of this audit.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Rien à corriger : c'est nécessaire au fo: Nothing to fix: this is required for Jeedom to work. Limit the exposure of the interface and only install trusted plugins.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un pare-feu limite les services joignabl: A firewall limits the services reachable from the network, for example by restricting SSH and the database to the local network.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Configurez un pare-feu (ufw ou nftables): Set up a firewall (ufw or nftables) that only opens the useful ports. Be careful not to block your own SSH access.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Fail2ban bannit automatiquement les adre: Fail2ban automatically bans addresses that repeat SSH login attempts or suspicious requests on Apache.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Installez et activez fail2ban, indispens: Install and enable fail2ban, essential if a port of the Internet router is forwarded to Jeedom. With no exposure detected, this check is only information.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.fail2ban va être installé en tâche de fo: fail2ban will be installed in the background (apt), with SSH protection and the Apache rules provided by Jeedom. Your local network is never banned. Follow the progress in the auditsecurity log, then run the audit again.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.La base de données de Jeedom n'a besoin: The Jeedom database only needs to be reachable locally. Open on the network, it is exposed to brute-force attacks.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Limitez MariaDB à la boucle locale (bind: Limit MariaDB to the loopback interface (bind-address = 127.0.0.1) if no other device connects to it.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom doit utiliser un compte dédié ave: Jeedom must use a dedicated account with a long password, not the database root account.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Créez un utilisateur dédié à Jeedom avec: Create a user dedicated to Jeedom with a random password of at least 12 characters.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un broker MQTT ouvert sans mot de passe: An MQTT broker open without a password lets any device on the network read and control your devices (Zigbee2MQTT, Tasmota, Shelly...). The plugin attempts an anonymous connection on the network address of the broker, then disconnects immediately without reading or publishing anything.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Désactivez allow_anonymous et définissez: Disable allow_anonymous and define a password_file (the MQTT Manager plugin does it automatically). If access to the MQTT port is already restricted by a firewall, you can ignore this check (risk accepted with a compensating control).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Certains services sont dangereux sur un: Some services are dangerous on a network: Telnet and FTP send passwords in clear text, the unencrypted Docker API gives root control of the machine, VNC, Redis or MongoDB often have no password.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Arrêtez et désinstallez ces services, ou: Stop and uninstall these services, or restrict them to the loopback interface (127.0.0.1). Use SSH instead of Telnet and FTP.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Liste des services joignables depuis le: List of the services reachable from the local network. Each one is a potential entry point: check that they are all useful.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Arrêtez les services inutiles et ne redi: Stop unused services and only forward the essential ports on your Internet router (ideally none, using Jeedom DNS or a VPN).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une sauvegarde récente permet de reparti: A recent backup lets you recover quickly after a failure, a mistake or a compromise.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Gardez la sauvegarde automatique de Jeed: Keep the Jeedom automatic backup enabled (daily).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une sauvegarde complète va être lancée e: A full backup will be started in the background.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Une sauvegarde stockée uniquement sur la: A backup stored only on the box disappears with it (dead SD card, ransomware, theft).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Activez l'envoi des sauvegardes vers le: Enable sending backups to the Jeedom cloud (Market) or a network share (Samba).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Un disque plein empêche les sauvegardes,: A full disk prevents backups and logs, and can corrupt the database.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Libérez de l'espace (anciennes sauvegard: Free up space (old backups, logs) or move to a larger storage device.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Aucune correction automatique pour ce co: No automatic fix for this check
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.port %d redirigé par UPnP vers le port %: port %d forwarded by UPnP to Jeedom port %d
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%s : date de fin de support inconnue du: %s: end-of-support date unknown to the plugin.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%s ne sera plus supporté à partir du %s: %s will no longer be supported from %s: plan the migration.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Authentification LDAP active : les mots: LDAP authentication enabled: passwords are managed by the directory.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Le compte « admin » n'utilise pas le mot: The "admin" account does not use the default password.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%d compte(s) avec un mot de passe trop c: %d account(s) with a too common password.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Aucun des %d compte(s) actif(s) n'utilis: None of the %d active account(s) uses a password from the tested list.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Tous les comptes actifs ont la double au: All active accounts have two-factor authentication.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Aucun accès externe n'est configuré : Je: No external access is configured: Jeedom only asks for two-factor authentication on logins from outside. Enable it if you open external access.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom est accessible depuis Internet (%: Jeedom is reachable from the Internet (%s) and %d administrator(s) do not have two-factor authentication.
Jeedom is reachable from the Internet (%s) and %d non-administrator account(s) do not have two-factor authentication.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.aucune connexion enregistrée par l'inter: no login recorded through the interface
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%d compte(s) actif(s) sans connexion dep: %d active account(s) with no login for more than 6 months.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Tous les comptes actifs ont été utilisés: All active accounts have been used in the last 6 months.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%d échec(s) autorisé(s) sur %d s, bannis: %d allowed failure(s) over %d s, ban of %s.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%s : couvre aussi des adresses publiques: %s: also covers public addresses, can be replaced by %s
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.%s : adresse publique, vérifiez qu'elle: %s: public address, check that it belongs to you
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.La liste blanche contient une entrée qui: The whitelist contains an entry covering the whole Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.La liste blanche ne contient que des pla: The whitelist only contains local ranges.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Aucune entrée à corriger automatiquement: No entry to fix automatically: check the public addresses by hand (Settings > Security).
Session duration set back to 24 hours.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.L'accès externe déclaré est en HTTP : %s: The declared external access uses HTTP: %s
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Accès externe par le DNS Jeedom, chiffré: External access through Jeedom DNS, encrypted with HTTPS.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les API du core sont restreintes ou désa: Core APIs are restricted or disabled.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Des API sont ouvertes, mais Jeedom n'est: Some APIs are open, but Jeedom is not exposed to the Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Ces API répondent depuis n'importe quell: These APIs answer from any address, and Jeedom is reachable from the Internet.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.La liste blanche est vide : renseignez-l: The whitelist is empty: fill it in (Settings > Security) before switching the APIs to White IP mode.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Les clés API font au moins 32 caractères: API keys are at least 32 characters long.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom %s est installé, la version %s es: Jeedom %s is installed, version %s is available.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Jeedom %s est à jour (selon la dernière: Jeedom %s is up to date (according to the last update check).
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Tous les plugins sont à jour (selon la d: All plugins are up to date (according to the last update check).
All plugins come from the Market.
The local interface (%s) does not respond.
plugins/auditsecurity/core/class/auditse.Ces emplacements sont accessibles depuis: These locations are reachable from the browser:
